summary: Retest after fix for /api/payments/create-intent placeholder Stripe key. Backend pytest: 24/24 PASS (100%). create-intent now correctly returns mode='mock' with pi_mock_<hex> id and *_secret_mock client_secret (verified via new assertions). mock-confirm flips booking.payment_status to 'succeeded' and unit.status to 'booked' (test_create_intent_and_mock_confirm asserts this against proj-1 unit). Regression smoke green: signup/login/me, projects list+filter+detail (no _id leak), pricing engine arithmetic, AI customize-room (Gemini Nano Banana base64), bookings, builder-only (403 for user), admin-only (403 for builder/user), admin verify/approve/stats. Frontend E2E booking flow as demo@user.com: Login -> Discover -> project card -> Aurelia Heights detail -> Customize & price (AI Studio) -> Book unit -> Booking screen -> Start Stripe payment (mock PaymentIntent created, button swaps to Confirm) -> Confirm token payment -> Success state with green checkmark 'Token booked!' rendered. No console errors observed during the run. The pre-existing pointerEvents deprecation warning is still in the codebase but not retested in this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: Mock-mode branch in create_intent uses a clean placeholder check (empty or 'sk_test_emergent' or non sk_test_/sk_live_ prefix). Logic is sound but the `not X and not Y` precedence relies on `or` being lower than `and`; works correctly but a parenthesized form would be more readable.

Mock PaymentIntent persists stripe_payment_intent_id=pi_mock_* and stripe_mode='mock' on the booking, which is good for traceability. /api/payments/mock-confirm is intentionally unrestricted to mode so it still works for both mock and live_test bookings in this demo.
Real Stripe path (sk_test_51... or sk_live_...) is preserved and untouched by the change.

The Stripe AuthenticationError on /api/payments/create-intent caused by the 'sk_test_emergent' placeholder is now bypassed by an explicit mock-mode branch in server.py:471-506 that detects the placeholder (empty, equals 'sk_test_emergent', or doesn't start with sk_test_/sk_live_) and synthesizes a pi_mock_<hex16> PaymentIntent + matching *_secret_mock client_secret, persisting stripe_mode='mock' on the booking. /api/payments/mock-confirm continues to mark the booking confirmed/paid and flip the matching unit to 'booked'.
